artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: THE RECORD THIS CELL EXISTS TO PRODUCE. Denominator with instrument and vintage, the subtraction with each exclusion band and its reason, the 13-row (member, current, target) table with provenance on both columns, and the domain falsification stated in both directions. It is a record; it deploys nothing and changes no classification.

Prints the denominator on the scan with its page check, the read-time vintage and the reason the rows' own last_updated is not one, plus a positive and a negative control. Reads a scan JSON from disk; performs no AWS call and no write.

The subtraction. Assigns all 285 rows to exactly one bucket and asserts the buckets sum back to the denominator, so a lost member breaks the run rather than the answer. Prints the rule ladder with its PRD citations, the arm that was NOT applied, and the substring trap. Pure function of its input file; no I/O, no write.

The member table. Reads CURRENT from a batch-get-item point-read response (a second instrument) rather than from the scan the subtraction used, and asserts the two agree. Reads two JSON files; no AWS call at run time, no write.

The corpus arms. Censuses every blob reachable from HEAD and from the portal pin through git cat-file --batch (cone-independent), parses the satellite necessary-data population, enumerates every repo site that binds a ticker to a class, and applies the ladder to the out-of-domain population. Reads git objects and two JSON files; no write.

The live-plane arm. Compares the chosen domain against the only other live ticker-keyed asset_class store and prints counts, the two vocabularies, the key-space gap and the 13-row agreement table. Retains counts and the 13 AC3 rows only -- the second store's content is not copied into the record. Reads two JSON files; no write.

mutant.description: FOUR PLANTED MUTANTS ON THE SUBTRACTION, run against copies of the scan in scratch (no live row was ever touched). M1: blank VNQ's sector field, expecting the twelfth member to disappear. M2: move GLD out of the hedge bucket (asset_class equity, sub 'US Large Cap', sector and name cleared), expecting an EXPECTED-BUT-ABSENT reading. M3: drop one row from the input, expecting the denominator and the arithmetic to move together. M1b, after M1 DID NOT FIRE: clear BOTH of VNQ's real-estate signals (sector AND name), expecting the set to collapse to exactly the standing eleven. Plus the separate in-run assertions that every row lands in exactly one bucket and that the buckets sum back to the denominator.
mutant.expected: M1 11 members; M2 11 members with GLD named as EXPECTED-BUT-ABSENT; M3 denominator 284 with the arithmetic still closing; M1b 11 members with BOTH delta directions NONE.
mutant.observed: M2 FIRED: 'SURVIVING RETAG MEMBER SET 11 | ARITHMETIC CLOSES: 274 excluded + 11 members == 285 | EXPECTED-BUT-ABSENT: [GLD]'. M3 FIRED: 'START -- THE DENOMINATOR: 284 rows | SURVIVING 12 | ARITHMETIC CLOSES: 272 excluded + 12 members == 284'. M1 DID NOT FIRE and the reason is recorded rather than hidden: the set stayed at 12 because R5 reads name, sector AND sub, and VNQ's NAME is 'Vanguard Real Estate ETF' -- so the mutation removed one of TWO independent signals, which is evidence ABOUT VNQ rather than a failure of the control. M1b, the sharpened mutant, FIRED EXACTLY: 'SURVIVING RETAG MEMBER SET 11 | ARITHMETIC CLOSES: 274 excluded + 11 members == 285 | R5 0 | PRESENT-BUT-UNEXPECTED: NONE | EXPECTED-BUT-ABSENT: NONE'. THAT IS THE CONTROL THAT MATTERS MOST HERE: the instrument returns EXACTLY the standing eleven when and only when the twelfth's evidence is absent, so it is not biased toward twelve and it is capable of returning eleven.
